batch.description: HSTU admission paper, academic session 2017-2018, transcribed 2026-10-31 from the HSTU section of Udvash's 'GST গুচ্ছ প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (TargetPDF/CamScanner scan, 8 PDF pages = printed book pp. 207-214). The source prints NO unit or set label anywhere (header states only session, full marks 100, MCQ, 1 hour 30 minutes), so the paper is recorded with unit 'unassigned'; unit identification must come from later question-level matching against an independent source and was NOT guessed here. 100 questions: Physics 25, Chemistry 25, Biology 25, English 25, each subject numbered independently 01-25 and split across syllabus-tier blocks (Short/Extra/Old) that re-use numbers; assembled here in printed-number order per subject. Answers are the compilation's own inline keys ([Ans: x] tags and/or worked-solution opening letters), recorded as printed, including one dual key (Chemistry 16, printed '(b+c)'). Single source only: content and answers are unverified; nothing in this pack is import-ready. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 16 of 100 questions verified. Unit identified as A by question-level content matching against Satt Academy's 2017 unit aggregates (all 30 public A-bank cards pair with this paper; B/D/F aggregates and named sets match none) — see VERIFICATION.md. sourceDocuments.title: Udvash GST cluster question bank — HSTU questions & solutions 2017-18 section (TargetPDF scan)
sourceDocuments.notes: Third-party CamScanner scan of Udvash's printed 'GST গুচ্ছ প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (running head 'HSTU প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান: ২০১৭-১৮', printed pp. 207-214), distributed via the 'Target PDF' Telegram channel (diagonal watermark on every page; Watermarkly and CS CamScanner stamps). 8 PDF pages holding exactly one 100-question paper. NO unit or set label is printed anywhere in the 8 pages. Keys are inline only (no answer table): [Ans: x] tags and/or worked solutions. This document is Udvash-derived and cannot corroborate any other Udvash-derived source; it is a transcription source only.
